sample_unit: survey respondents (medical physics and clinical engineering professionals)

links.outcome: Staff preparedness for AI introduction by prior AI education; awareness of training resources
links.effect: Only 13% of respondents without prior AI education felt prepared, rising about threefold with education. Only 10% had prior AI education, and only 23% knew where to find training resources.
links.quote: Without prior education on AI, only 13% of respondents feel prepared for AI introduction; but this increases by a factor of three with education.

screen.reason: Empirical survey of 409 UK medical physics and clinical engineering professionals assessing current AI usage, preparedness, governance concerns, and barriers to deployment.
